purpose: Teach: 恐るべき/逆行/あの世/極意/陳腐/囚われ/円満/時代遅れ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが恐るべき体力をお持ちだった
lines.en: Your father had remarkable physical strength when he was young, Gran.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle pace. Voice settles into memory. Warm regard—not mourning, but reflecting on something admired. Slight pause before speaking, as if gathering the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、時代の流れに逆行されない方だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, he was never one to resist the flow of the times, was he, dear?
lines.style: Knowing, warm tone. A light confirmation that carries the weight of shared history. Gentle lilt at the end—coaxing agreement, not demanding it. Voice has the comfortable familiarity of speaking to someone she's known decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがあの世のお話をされた
lines.en: Your father used to tell us stories about the other world when we were young.
lines.style: Quieter, more contemplative. Draws the listener in—as if sharing something precious. Breath is measured. The wistfulness deepens; this is not just memory but something he wanted to pass on.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、剣道の極意を孫に教えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He taught your grandchildren the deeper principles of kendo, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Pride underneath—not boastful, just clear-eyed recognition. Slight rise at the end—inviting confirmation rather than stating fact. Voice carries the satisfaction of something done well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは陳腐な常識を疑われた
lines.en: He questioned the platitudes everyone else accepted without thinking when he was young.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost philosophical tone. Slower pacing on the core idea. Voice carries quiet respect for that questioning spirit. Trailing thought—as if still considering what that meant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、過去に囚われない方でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He never let himself be held captive by the past, even when people called him old-fashioned, did he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate correction, gently spoken. Warmth in defending his memory. Voice rises slightly with conviction—this matters. Ending tag 'dear' is intimate, almost conspiratorial, like sharing a secret understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ご家族が円満で過ごせた
lines.en: The family stayed at peace with one another when we were younger.
lines.style: Softly wistful, almost fragile. Gentle attack on the opening. Pace slows—lingering on what was good. Voice carries both gratitude and the ache of recognizing something precious that has passed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、時代遅れと笑われてもご自分の信念を貫かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He held true to his own beliefs, even when the world laughed at him for it, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Firm beneath the gentleness. Pride and tenderness intertwined. Voice strengthens slightly on the affirmation of his integrity. Closing 'dear' is warm and intimate—two people who understand each other completely.
